hints.forceFresh: This load skipped IndexedDB after “Reset to a blank board”.
hints.backupRestored: Primary list was unreadable; restored from the last good backup.
hints.listCorrupt: Primary list JSON is corrupt or not { state: { files: [] } }. Often followed a interrupted write when backups were deleted (backups are now kept).
hints.listAndBackupGone: Both primary list and backup are unusable; started blank.
hints.idbOpenFail: IndexedDB open/read threw (not necessarily “empty”). Check whether keyval-store fails to open.
hints.idbInternal: Browser reported UnknownError: Internal error — usually a corrupt or locked keyval-store. The app retries and may rebuild that database.
hints.persistRebuilt: Rebuilt local keyval-store and saved again successfully. If issues remain, close other tabs for this site and refresh.
hints.checkKeyvalStore: DevTools → Application → IndexedDB → keyval-store → PAINT-BOARD-FILES / PAINT-BOARD-FILES-BACKUP.
hints.closeOtherTabs: Close other tabs for this site (IndexedDB may be blocked).
hints.quota: Storage quota exceeded; large boards or background images can cause this.
hints.blocked: IndexedDB upgrade/delete blocked by another tab.
hints.rehydrate: Zustand rehydrate callback failed; continued with a blank board.
hints.persistFail: This save failed; existing local files are not overwritten until a save succeeds.

features.freeDrawingDesc1: Provides 15 brush styles: basic, pen, outlined pen, rainbow, multi-shape, material, pixels, multi-color, text, multi-line, mesh, multi-point, wave, thorn, and ink
features.freeDrawingDesc2: All brushes support customization of color and brush width
features.freeDrawingDesc3: Multi-shape brush supports flexible configuration of shape type and quantity
features.freeDrawingDesc4: Material brush and multi-color brush can customize material types
features.freeDrawingDesc5: Text brush supports loop text and font configuration
features.shapeDrawingDesc1: Supports drawing rich graphics, including built-in graphics and Lucide icon library graphics, just click to add and use
features.shapeDrawingDesc2: Configurable line width, line style, fill color and fill style
features.eraserModeDesc1: Supports linear erasing of any drawn content
features.selectModeDesc1: Supports clicking or box selecting content for editing
features.selectModeDesc2: After selection, you can drag, scale, and rotate through handles
features.selectModeDesc3: Each element supports the following settings
features.selectModeDesc3_1: Layer management: move up, move down, bring to front, send to back
features.selectModeDesc3_2: Eraser switch: when enabled, eraser can erase current element
features.selectModeDesc3_3: Lock switch: when enabled, current object cannot move, rotate or scale
features.selectModeDesc4: Image elements support multiple filter effects
features.selectModeDesc5: Text elements support font, bold, italic and other style adjustments
features.boardModeDesc1: Board background settings, supports color, background image, camera multiple backgrounds, supports simultaneous display, draggable display hierarchy
features.boardModeDesc1_1: Background color: supports solid color, gradient, transparency configuration
features.boardModeDesc1_2: Background image: supports transparency and background removal and image segmentation configuration when uploading images
features.boardModeDesc1_3: Camera: supports real-time shooting and freeze current frame as background, adjustable filter, brightness, contrast, saturation and transparency
features.boardModeDesc2: Board size supports custom width and height
features.boardModeDesc3: Drawing cache: In the presence of a large amount of drawing content, enabling cache will improve drawing performance, while disabling cache will improve canvas sharpness
features.boardModeDesc4: Guide lines: when enabled, convenient for multi-element dragging alignment
features.bottomLeftDesc1: Help button: click to open help popup, supports language switching and viewing shortcuts and feature descriptions
features.bottomLeftDesc2: Circular progress bar: real-time display of current zoom ratio, click to reset zoom ratio
features.bottomLeftDesc3: Camera button: displays current camera status, supports multiple display configurations
features.bottomOperationDesc1: Functions from left to right are: undo, redo, copy current selection, delete current selection, draw text, upload image, clear drawing content, save as image, open layer list, open file list
features.bottomOperationDesc1_1: Upload image supports background removal, image segmentation. This function requires browser support for WebGPU, recommend using the latest version of Google Chrome
features.bottomOperationDesc1_2: Save as image supports custom configuration. Rotate, scale, crop
features.fileListDesc: Supports multiple canvas switching, each canvas can customize title, add, delete, and provides upload and download functions
features.internationalizationDesc: Supports Chinese (Simplified), Chinese (Traditional), English, Japanese, Korean

helpInfo.openSourceRepoDesc: A star is the best support I can get. Thank you.
helpInfo.docsDesc: Open this for a detailed guide to the app.

guide.portraitOps: Left rail: pan/select, undo/redo, insert, clean, and common actions
guide.portraitChrome: Right rail: layers, boards, fullscreen, orientation, language, help, zoom, camera
guide.portraitDraw: Top-left Draw opens the tools panel from the left (clears the right rail)
guide.portraitLegend: Bottom-center legend toggle shows/hides labels next to icons
guide.desktopOps: Bottom dock: pan/select, undo/redo, insert, clean, and common actions
guide.desktopChrome: Top-right chrome: layers, boards, fullscreen (orientation hidden on desktop)
guide.desktopDraw: Top-left Draw opens the floating tools panel
guide.desktopLegend: Bottom-right legend toggle controls global labels
guide.desktopHelp: Bottom-left (top-left in landscape): language, help, zoom, camera
guide.panelTools: Tools: opens with a dim mask; tap the mask to close
guide.panelBoards: Boards: from the right in portrait, centered overlay otherwise
guide.panelWidgets: Widgets: expands from the top center
guide.panelDim: Open panels use a translucent mask — tap it to dismiss
guide.panelMutex: On narrow portrait, only one primary panel stays open at a time
guide.drawingModes: Tools panel switches draw, eraser, select, and board settings
guide.drawingBrushes: Free drawing includes many brushes; letter badges hint shortcuts
guide.drawingScroll: On desktop, scroll the panel with the mouse wheel
guide.drawingCols: On touch, tall panel content spills into a second column
guide.drawingKeys: Keyboard: B brush, E eraser (1/2 still work). Full list under This device
guide.capOrientation: Orientation lock usually needs fullscreen; failures show a toast
guide.capFullscreen: Fullscreen failures show a toast instead of failing silently
guide.capDesktopNoOrientation: Desktop hides orientation toggle (browsers cannot reliably lock it)
guide.capGestures: Touch: two-finger pan/zoom, two-finger double-tap undo, three-finger double-tap redo
guide.capMouse: Mouse: wheel zoom, space-drag pan, right-click select/marquee
guide.capLegend: Legend toggle applies to dock, rails, and panel labels globally
